entries.speaker: Dungeon Battle Commands
entries.en: Pressing [clr 2][f 1 10 44][clr 27] while you are investigating[n]a dungeon will halt your movement and[n]open [clr 2]Battle Commands[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Dungeon Battle Commands
entries.en: Enemies won't move while you have[n]Battle Commands open, so you can use[n][clr 2]Infiltration Tools[clr 27] to surprise them.

entries.speaker: Dungeon Battle Commands
entries.en: You can also use [clr 2]Auto-Recover[clr 27][n]to immediately heal your party members.[n]Keep this in mind during your investigations.
